feature: listener-owned multi-connection WebTransport over HTTP/2 manager

scope.transport: draft-ietf-webtrans-http2-15 Capsule protocol over certificate-verified TLS with h2 ALPN
scope.ownership: one EndpointListener owns the HTTP/2 listener, bounded connection slots, per-connection EndpointServer owners and a bounded cross-connection pending-request ring
scope.handles: composite connection and Session generations prevent stale handles after connection-slot reuse
operations: virtual stream open, send, consume, retire, reset and stop
scope.cleartext_boundary: h2c transport ownership is allowed, but WebTransport Session admission requires encrypted transport and returns EncryptionRequired before opening CONNECT

implementation.acceptance: configurable concurrent accept workers reserve fixed connection slots before TCP/TLS/HTTP2 handshake ownership
implementation.backpressure: a fixed pending-request ring blocks only the producing connection worker when full
implementation.failure_isolation: one connection stopping removes only its generation, wakes capacity admission and leaves sibling endpoint workers active
implementation.shutdown: listener close requests every EndpointServer to stop, joins manager workers, closes the owned listener and preserves retained pending requests until they observe EndpointClosed
implementation.allocation: construction, connection adoption and partial accept-worker startup have transactional ownership; a fail-first allocation sweep verifies cleanup
implementation.structure: the public facade, ownership core, public routing runtime and real-network tests live under the endpoint_listener module boundary

results.tls_multi_connection: two connections were admitted in either arrival order, exchanged independently routed DATAGRAMs, and connection B survived connection A shutdown
results.generation_reuse: a third TLS connection reused A's bounded slot with a different generation and completed admission and DATAGRAM delivery
results.retained_pending_shutdown: a pending request retained across listener destruction returned EndpointClosed without a leak or stale access
results.h2c_security: a cleartext owner completed HTTP/2 setup while WebTransport CONNECT returned EncryptionRequired with zero local request streams
results.slow_handshake_isolation: one silent TCP peer held a reserved TLS handshake slot while a second accept worker completed an authenticated WebTransport Session within the original 3-second deadline
results.hyper_http2_regression: independent Hyper h2c/TLS client and server matrix passed all 9/9 build steps, including multiplexing, cancellation, GOAWAY, pooling, redirects and TLS KeyUpdate

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='WebTransport HTTP2 EndpointListener' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -Dtest-filter='WebTransport HTTP2 EndpointListener' --summary all
remaining_gap: No independent draft-15 WebTransport-over-HTTP2 browser or proxy implementation is available in the local reference set; automatic EndpointClient reconnection also remains separate work.
